Title: Category and priority interpretation
Statement: Category routing or priority could be inconsistent without exact mappings and first-satisfied Critical-to-Low precedence.
Mitigation_or_Resolution: Freeze the four category routes; evaluate Critical, High, Medium, then Low; the first satisfied level controls; verify the representative input twice.
Next_Action: Retain the mapping and precedence in the model.

Title: Four-role sufficiency
Statement: The bounded scenario assumes the two-stage intake model fits within eight states and four roles.
Mitigation_or_Resolution: Keep Stage A in Draft-to-Submitted and Stage B in the Submitted-to-ClarificationRequested loop; confirm every action has one of the four modeled owners.
Next_Action: Revisit only if an orphan responsibility appears.

Title: Stale completeness result
Statement: Stage-B resubmission initially retained a stale result after missing reporting-period and exception-filter details were supplied.
Mitigation_or_Resolution: Resolve DEF-001 by recalculating completeness on every resubmission and verify return to Submitted.

Title: Readiness exit evidence
Statement: Simulated go/no-go depends on all UAT cases reaching final PASS and both defects having passing retests.
Mitigation_or_Resolution: Reconcile eight final PASS results and two resolved defects before CUT-004.

Title: Premature closure
Statement: The initial model could close without explicit requester acceptance.
Mitigation_or_Resolution: Resolve DEF-002; enforce the validation gate; include recovery guidance in RUN-002.
Next_Action: Monitor the gate in smoke checks and modeled hypercare.

Title: Support handoff evidence
Statement: Handoff depends on requester decision, resolution summary, accountable owner, category, support reference, handoff note, three runbooks, and a reconciled ownership matrix.
Mitigation_or_Resolution: Require the six closure/handoff fields; runbook readiness; smoke evidence; and CUT-007 handoff confirmation.

Title: Two-stage intake and platform-neutral configuration
Statement: Adopt the Stage-A gate; Stage-B completeness loop; category; priority; assignment; communication; closure rules; eight-state workflow; and one accountable Fulfiller.
Decision_Rationale: Concrete rules make decisions reviewable without pretending to configure a tool.
Next_Action: Freeze the rule set at CUT-002.

Title: Retests required before readiness
Statement: Require both bounded findings to receive a documented correction and passing retest before CUT-004 performs simulated go/no-go.
Mitigation_or_Resolution: Approved and verified after both retests passed.
Decision_Rationale: Readiness is not credible until the stale result and closure guard pass reciprocal retests.

Title: Simulated GO resulting from CUT-004
Statement: Record the simulated GO produced by CUT-004 after prerequisites pass; the decision then governs CUT-005 through CUT-007.
Mitigation_or_Resolution: CUT-004 produced simulated GO; no deployment occurs.
Decision_Rationale: Downstream transition; smoke; and handoff evidence cannot be prerequisites for the decision.
Next_Action: Proceed to CUT-005; CUT-006 and CUT-007 provide downstream evidence.
